title: Chapter 43
text: ∫ So you’ve got a talking cat. I mean, that’s hot bananas. And he listens to the answering machine. I’ve got 6 cats and not a damned one of them speaks even pidgin English . . . You ever thought of putting that cat on the poetry reading circuit? Think of him doing The Inferno . Or maybe he writes his own stuff. Is he fixed? The ladies just love to blow and screw the poets. We know that.
